status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Lopez (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the 49ers, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
status.longComment: Lopez has been dealing with the groin issue for a few weeks. He didn't practice Wednesday or Thursday, and while he was limited during Friday's session, he is still considered questionable to play in Week 3. If Lopez isn't available against the 49ers, Andrew Billings may be in line for extra snaps.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Cardinals placed Johnson (neck) on injured reserve  Wednesday, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.
status.longComment: Johnson suffered a neck injury in the 31-7 loss to the Seahawks in Week 2. He was placed on injured reserve, so he is guaranteed to miss at least four games. However, the 23-year-old isn't expected to play again this season. If that's the case, he will finish the year with eight total tackles (three solo), one fumble recovery and one pass defended. Without Johnson, Garrett Williams (Achilles), who has yet to play this season, could take on a larger role upon his return. Max Melton (toe), Kei'Trel Clark and Starling Thomas, the latter who was promoted from the practice squad, may also be more involved.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Melton (toe) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus San Francisco, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
status.longComment: Melton didn't practice Wednesday and was limited Thursday and Friday. He's now considered questionable for the Week 3 meeting with the 49ers. Garrett Williams (Achilles) doesn't hold an injury designation, so his availability will help lessen the blow if Melton can't get on the field.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Taylor-Demerson (back) is listed as out for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
status.longComment: Taylor-Demerson didn't practice Wednesday but was limited Thursday, indicating he was making progress toward being available in Week 3. However, he took a step backward by not practicing again Friday, resulting in his second absence of the 2026 campaign. Without Taylor-Demerson in the mix Sunday, Wydett Williams may need to be more involved.
